title: The founding ledger's inventory hint text ('the first Reeve's own account of the crown — read it') never updates after the item is actually read: I used 'use the founding ledger' at the Hall of Ledgers and read its full contents, then later showed/discussed it with Regent Ysolde at the Hollow Throne, but the inventory line still read '...read it' verbatim in the final status screen at turn 602.
